scope: Two actual automated Minecraft clients; host native local channel and separate offline UUID peer real TCP. Four mods with Forge, not full modpack, two humans, headless GameTests or survival acquisition. Supplied gear/environments and original native hurt/physical arrows are labeled per case.

coverage.nativeC2SEquipment: All84 cases actual InventoryScreen + MultiPlayerGameMode.handleInventoryMouseClick equip/unequip; original server LivingEquipmentChange thresholds.
coverage.nativeSources: Actual peer primary attacks, host primary shield blocks, sleep wake C2S, original enchantment menu buttons, minister interact, exam/flute use and original physical arrows where indicated. Fire/incoming lethal/native boss encounter ledger and random trials are QA supplied fixtures, not all C2S.
coverage.clients: All selected cases have server result plus both AFTER_LEVEL rendered client captures. Some legacy cases capture after unequip only; per-row equippedFrameAvailable is explicit.
coverage.nativeLongClock: run03 real6000tick lastStand and3600tick cicada, plus600tick draco lease; no gameTime writes. DayTime environmental changes are separate. QilinShield/taiyiGlow initial deadlines verified, actual6000tick expiration not separately waited.
coverage.death: receipt-death.json: actual both death screens/C2S respawn preserve lastStand/cicada/guard lease/generation, no early life-save bypass. Root permanent progress whitelist is outside scope.
coverage.restart: NOT ACCEPTED: run11 isolated copied-world native load remained at ConfirmScreen before world entry, stopped only own JVMs. No actual restart/relog persistence pass is claimed; see run11/restart-not-accepted.json.

wholeRowsSafeToDelete: 对 28 套分别完成 2/3/4 件实机触发与卸装测试，重点检查临时效果、蓄势、反击窗口、召唤物、无敌帧和保命冷却是否残留。
todo.firstMechanismRow: Recommend closure for main review:84/84 native mechanism tiers, original trigger/unwear checks plus corrected native leather4 outcome.
todo.secondOwnershipRow: Retain confirmed lease crab unprovoked nonEnemy bystander targeting defect. Repeated C2S equip/unwear UUID nonstacking now passed28 sets×3 cycles; leave only actual residual ownership defect and any independent required scope.
